summary: Heading into Wednesday, Wall Street is mixed on US election day with tech steadying, while firmer oil and the vote outcome keep caution in place after India's four-day run.

detail.leaders: Exchange stocks after strong MCX and NSE results; staples momentum
detail.laggards: Oil-sensitive names if crude extends its rebound; IT if US tech wobbles
detail.tone: Forward-looking evening read: a touch better than at 18:00, as US tech opened higher, but the midterm result and Iran-linked oil moves can still swing the open.
